why_not_ready: the commission gates this fan-in on the exact R7 six-file court producing 55 collected and 55/55 twice. That gate is structurally unreachable on the current-control lineage, so the candidate cannot honestly be declared R9_ACCEPTED_RUNTIME_FANIN_READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.

primary_reason.statement: 30 of the R7 court's 55 tests live in three court files that the current-control lineage has never carried.
primary_reason.provenance: all three were introduced by the separate accepted C3 source-free repair lineage (fe9ec0361, 105246b33, 5fbf9cc56, siblings of 1f9990fec and 30686b185), none of which is an ancestor of control ff4f0695; they are absent from the commissioned startup SHA 26e92e6 as well
primary_reason.not_imported_because: they are out-of-scope C3/C4 closed35 court content, and the commission forbids importing unrelated historical side-branch content or improvising a resolution
primary_reason.hq_decision_required: either authorise the C3 closed35 court files as an explicitly scoped additional dependency of this fan-in, or re-specify the R7 gate against the court files the control lineage actually carries

secondary_reason.statement: the fan-in is not purely additive: the accepted decoder breaks exactly two accepted control-lineage tests.
secondary_reason.mechanism: the control-lineage carrier asserts the source-identity gate hashes through decoder._sha and that normal decode routes through the chunked reader; the accepted decoder reaches the same fail-closed outcome through the broker-governed _governed_source_sha path and a restructured declaration-aware reader route
secondary_reason.hq_decision_required: adjudicate whether the accepted decoder supersedes these control-lineage assertions (in which case the two control tests are retired by that adjudication) or whether a compatibility repair to the decoder is required. This worker deliberately did not choose.
